bio: This inviting establishment has its fair share of regulars, and deservedly so. One of the main attractions is its location right by the Rhine – tables with a view of the river, as well as those on the gorgeous terrace, are in high demand. No less captivating are the creations of chef-patron Guy de Vries, whose French heritage shines through in work. Drawing from the bounty of each season, he concocts mouthwatering plates with a Mediterranean twist. The well-curated wine list includes an impressive selection of Champagnes. Friendly and adept service....
